$description: orch Mission Control design tokens (other apps copy the generated tokens.css). DTCG Format 2025.10 (https://www.designtokens.org/TR/2025.10/format/). Three layers: primitive (raw values, never used in CSS directly), semantic (meaning; light value in $value, dark in $extensions.io.orch.ds.dark), component (sizes per density). $extensions.io.orch.ds.css names the generated CSS custom property; existing names (--bg, --ok-bg, ...) are kept so templates do not change.

series.$description: Chart series colours (categorical, colour-blind safe order). Light and dark values; charts read them via --series-N.

mono.$description: The phone app may prepend its bundled IBM Plex Mono.

page.$description: Page background behind cards (elevation: sunken in light, base in dark).

inset.$description: Blocks inside a card: gated text, excerpts, agent prose, code.

raised.$description: Focused or armed card; in dark higher means lighter.

hover.$description: Hover fill for rows, quiet buttons, nav items.

nav-active.$description: Selected nav item fill. Neutral on purpose: green means done.

subtle.$description: Decorative separators and card borders (no contrast requirement).

strong.$description: Decorative dashed empties, chart outlines. Never a control border.

control.$description: Input, select, button and checkbox boundaries; >= 3:1 on page and surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

control-overlay.$description: Control boundaries on overlay and chip-coloured surfaces (dialog, palette, drawer, a selected nav item or chip; #2A2F36 in dark). The dark overlay #2A2F36 is lighter than the page, so the plain control border would drop to 2.85:1 there; this keeps >= 3:1 (3.19 dark, 3.85 light).

link.$description: Links only. Underlined in running text (G183); headings never take it.

primary.$description: Ink primary button fill (one per card). Dark uses #E6E8EB so stacked primaries do not glare.

danger.$description: Revoke, delete, tidy. Never for trust or approve.

mint.$description: Brand and focus accent: logo, nav-active bar, dark focus ring, inbox-zero mark. Never text on light, never a status.

ok.$description: Done, passed, approved, healthy. Never 'fresh data'.

fg.$description: Text and icon on -bg and on surface (>= 4.5:1).

info.$description: Active: an agent working, running, in progress.

fg.$description: Text and icon on -bg and on surface (>= 4.5:1).

you.$description: Needs you. Core only; addons cannot use it. One pink element per decision.

fg.$description: Text and icon on -bg and on surface (>= 4.5:1).

warn.$description: Warning, stale, login needed, blocked by another ticket.

fg.$description: Text and icon on -bg and on surface (>= 4.5:1).
Text and icon on -bg and on surface (>= 4.5:1).

neu.$description: Neutral: open, draft, simulated, not started.

fg.$description: Text and icon on -bg and on surface (>= 4.5:1).

series.$description: Chart series 1-4. Never role colours: a series has no status meaning.

space.$description: 4-pt spacing; the only spacing values allowed in app.css.

item.$description: Item titles: ticket key + title, nested card titles (h3). Weight 650 where the variable font allows.

control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects. Phone 16 px so iOS does not zoom on focus.

meta.$description: Timestamps, labels, captions, chips. Sentence case, never uppercase-tracked.

stat.$description: KV(stats) values and Tile values; tabular numerals.

raised.$description: Pairs with surface.raised. Light: lift by shadow; dark: lift by lighter surface (Atlassian elevation).

layout.$description: Card collapses to receipt, overlay in. Never above 400 ms.
Viewport breakpoints are for the shell only; everything inside <main> responds to its container. CSS cannot read custom properties in @media/@container, so the generator inlines these numbers.

shell.$description: Below: top bar + drawer menu. At/above: 248 px sidebar.

split.$description: At/above: main + 320 px aside side by side. Below: aside stacks (decision-relevant aside parts first).

wide.$description: Content max-width kicks in; 3-up grids allowed.

narrow.$description: < 400: phone column, 320 aside. Stack everything; tables become labelled rows; actions full width.

medium.$description: 400-559: half-width card. KV side-by-side; tables of <= 3 columns as tables.

wide.$description: >= 800: full page. Tables of <= 6 columns as tables; grids 3-up.

measure.$description: Max width of running text and forms.

component.$description: Component tokens. Default value = comfortable density, fine pointer. $extensions io.orch.ds.compact applies under html[data-density=compact]; .coarse under @media (pointer: coarse) and always wins over compact for hit targets.

height.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, filter chips, segmented control.

gap.$description: Between stacked cards and between addon slot groups.

rail.$description: Role rail on decision cards, callouts, role cards.

height.$description: Table rows, list rows, nav items; 44 again on coarse pointers whatever the density.

max-words.$description: Status chips carry an icon and <= 3 words; longer text is a Callout or Text.

touch.$description: Touch target on coarse pointers (the phone app overrides to 48).

terminal.$description: Mission Control's Terminals (issue #40): a terminal screen and its chrome stay dark in both themes, like the terminal they show.
